title: The Hard Debt
premise: Financial-crimes investigator Lena Vane receives a debt collection from a stranger claiming her late father saved his life in a deal she has no memory of — and the interest is a ledger implicating Meridian Trust, the institution that trained her and laundered a fortune through her own clean cases. As Lena verifies the ledger, she discovers her mentor orchestrated her entire career as a laundering conduit, and the stranger, Tomas, is the son of the man her father actually betrayed. Torn between duty and a growing bond with Tomas, she burns the network from inside during a single night, ending at a shifting border checkpoint where she chooses love and ruin over the institution, exposing Meridian at the cost of her name.
about_author: Rafael Dunmore is a former compliance auditor who spent a decade tracing money across Eastern European borders before turning to fiction. He writes from a coastal town whose banks outnumber its churches.

chapters.title: Interest Owed
chapters.summary: Lena Vane's POV. A stranger, Tomas, appears at her office with a ledger and a claim: her father saved his father's life in a deal she can't verify — and now interest is owed. Her first instinct is protocol; her second is the ledger's impossible accuracy about Meridian Trust. Emotional beat: the unease of a rule-follower handed a rule she can't find.

chapters.title: The Clean Money Problem
chapters.summary: Dual POV, Lena and Tomas. Lena traces the ledger's transactions and realizes her own closed cases were laundering vehicles — her career was built to look legitimate. Tomas reveals his father died because of her father's betrayal, and he wants Meridian burned, not just exposed. Emotional beat: vertigo as her identity inverts from investigator to instrument.

chapters.title: Checkpoint at Midnight
chapters.summary: Tomas's POV, with Lena. They plan to exfiltrate the ledger through a border checkpoint whose shift change gives them a nine-minute window, but Meridian's enforcer — her mentor, Aldous — anticipates them, forcing Lena to feed him a false trail while confronting the man who raised her professionally and used her completely. Emotional beat: love against duty crystallizing into a decision.

chapters.title: The Hard Debt
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. At the checkpoint, Lena uploads the ledger publicly as Aldous closes in, sacrificing her reputation and freedom to detonate Meridian from outside its walls. Tomas crosses; she stays to face the consequences, but her evidence makes her untouchable — a witness, not a suspect. Emotional beat: found family over institution; the debt is finally paid in the only currency that mattered.
